native_attributes.summary: Two separate magnified endocrine tissue specimens. A sectioned thyroid follicle shows extracellular colloid, polarized epithelium and local circulation; a solid parathyroid specimen shows distinct cells and its own circulation. Nine enlarged static schematic callouts teach endocrine input and release.
native_attributes.scale_note: 500 µm per model unit. Cells, basal lamina, vessel calibres and signaling symbols are enlarged teaching representations. Thyroid and parathyroid are separate sampled tissues, not a whole-organ reconstruction; the flat exposed faces are specimen cuts. Signal arrows are static schematics, not molecular structures or ducts.

01 Both specimens + signals.note: Two distinct magnified tissue specimens under one selector. All normal tissue, both separate circulation networks and all nine static schematic callouts remain visible. This view uses the existing review-v2 home direction and native bounds fitting.

02 Tissue architecture.note: Anatomy-only comparison of colloid-filled follicles with a solid parathyroid cell population; hide the entire schematic signaling layer together.

03 Intact specimen surfaces.note: Optional uncut anatomy view. Inspect retained coverings and tissue boundaries without implying permanent half-removal of every basal lamina; all signaling is hidden because its arrows are authored for the teaching section.

04 Follicle polarity.note: Sectioned prominent left follicle: colloid lumen → apical epithelium → basal lamina → local blood. Basal lamina is a follicular layer, not the organ capsule. No layer is hidden within this specimen.

05 Follicular endocrine sequence.note: Follow the existing static TSH and four-step thyroglobulin/storage/uptake/T3-T4 sequence. Cell processing lies between colloid storage and release toward blood; no direct lumen-to-vessel transport is depicted.

06 C cell to local blood.note: C-cell identity and calcitonin route. The C cell is basal/interfollicular and does not face the colloid. The arrow is a static schematic relation, not a capillary or secretion tube.

07 Parathyroid organization + PTH.note: Separate solid parathyroid specimen with chief cells, oxyphil cells, adipocytes and its own circulation. Low extracellular Ca²⁺ is the input; chief-cell PTH is the output. There is no colloid inside this specimen.

08 Separate circulation beds.note: Optional vascular dissection: trace each specimen’s own supply, capillary anastomoses and drainage. Cells and stroma are deliberately hidden only in this view. Open ends at specimen cuts do not imply connection between the two samples.

09 Parathyroid intracellular detail.note: Start with the sectioned parathyroid cell population. Use the optional exact-name focus actions to x-ray surrounding cell bodies and expose oxyphil mitochondria or the peripheral adipocyte nucleus/lipid droplet; those actions do not move or resize structures.

focus_actions.purpose: Identify inside-to-outside order; ghosting is optional and user-invoked, never part of opening.
Select intracellular uptake droplets, which are not colloid cells or follicle-margin lacunae. Native frame_structures will frame the full aggregated parts, not one individual follicle.
Native x-ray focus exposes the organelles while retaining surrounding body context.
Native x-ray focus demonstrates lipid droplet and displaced nucleus in the magnified representation.

label_hierarchy.opening: Use existing native adaptive callouts with all nine Signal items label=true and labels_on_open=true. Preserve all normal layers. Native pixel eligibility manages small structures; no new fixed-label overlay.
label_hierarchy.overview: Two specimen identities and local circulation are the first conceptual layer; exact part names remain unchanged.
label_hierarchy.follicle_detail: Layer polarity precedes the static four-step endocrine sequence; the native section identifies colloid, epithelium and basal lamina.
label_hierarchy.parathyroid_detail: Chief/oxyphil/adipocyte identity precedes intracellular focus actions.
label_hierarchy.crowding_constraint: The existing model-scoped opening path forces max_landmarks >=60. With 30 possible item hosts this stays below native group-collapse threshold of 0.6*60=36. Do not lower the cap enough to collapse the nine signaling names into one generic group label.
label_hierarchy.unsupported: No native per-preset label priority, label mask, focus_parts field, or cut_at override is claimed. Focus uses the existing ModelView.focus_parts/micro_focus hook. Notes document purpose but are not guaranteed on-screen captions.
label_hierarchy.focused_scale_disclosure: The distant existing Signal symbols enlarged legend is hidden in tightly framed views 05–07 rather than falsely claiming an off-frame label is readable. Those views retain the model scale_note disclosure; opening still displays all nine original symbols.

frozen_geometry_policy.native_coordinate_space: native MicroModel xyz; do not copy these cameras into the GLB sidecar without coordinate conversion
frozen_geometry_policy.immutable_before_after: The same teaching-sidecar contract may be attached independently to each produced variant; never derive Pre refine from the legacy original or display both variants together.

visual_review.existing_evidence: Saved CHANGES.md expressly states no images were rendered or inspected. opening-checks.json uses synthetic pixel buffers only.

deferred_checks: Real native frame at opening: both specimens fit; one useful follicle section and parathyroid section visible; all approved nine signaling labels remain distinct.
Verify the longer exact signal labels do not cross or leave the viewport at supported window sizes.
Verify arrow 3 and intracellular uptake vesicles are clearly distinguished; section geometry alone does not establish real visible pixels.
Inspect view 06 framing against the source-seated C-cell position; its camera is proposed from the prominent follicle and requires actual pixel checking.
Validate all named views restore exact hidden lists and cut_on; return from focus must clear ghost focus and selection.
Verify all six follicles retain basal lamina when cut is disabled; optional vascular dissection is not used to hide geometry flaws.
Independently repeat teaching-state and color checks for newly built Pre refine and Post refine outputs.
